purpose: Correct ambiguous fourth-letter w in variants A, C and D after visual review.

corrections.prompt:
Edit image 1. Image 2 is a supporting LETTER-ANATOMY REFERENCE: its "26B / SOFTENED" wordmark correctly spells the brand.
There is one critical correction to image 1: the large wordmark currently reads "anyvay" because its fourth letter is a v. Replace that fourth letter with a properly drawn, unambiguous LOWERCASE w. The final word must read EXACTLY "anyway", a-n-y-w-a-y.
A w is a DOUBLE v: FOUR DIAGONAL STROKES, TWO LOW BOTTOM VERTICES and a CENTRAL HIGH APEX. It must have visibly TWO downward valleys. A single V shape is wrong. Use the fully formed w anatomy from image 2, but give it the sharp flat terminals appropriate to image 1. Leave a narrow clear dark separation between y and w; do not simplify or combine w with the y. A real distinctive w is more important than a ligature. Keep the brand's original bold geometric style, circular single-storey a letters, upright n, flat terminals and diagonal y descenders.
Make the SAME exact complete wordmark appear in the small website header below. Both wordmarks must unmistakably read "anyway". Also ensure the final y has a clean uninterrupted diagonal descender, without any stray cuts or extra spikes.
Preserve everything else in image 1: its exact variant label, dark background, composition, the full navigation header (docs, slash, Search, GitHub), hero typography, buttons, spacing, colors and aspect ratio. This is a focused letterform correction, not a redesign. For the COMPACT variant retain its narrower proportions; for BALANCED retain its medium width; for DIAGONAL JOIN retain crisp matching diagonal cuts while preserving a full w.
